title: Implement UX contrast-sculpting and spacing-proportion system for tokens
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: introduce a small, pragmatic token update that 1) rebalances semantic color anchors using perceptual contrast-sculpting (improve legibility across dense UIs), 2) replace fixed spacing tokens with a spacing-proportion system (ratio-based spacing tokens to reduce duplication), 3) provide a compact radius scale tuned for gesture targets, and 4) unify elevation presets with clearer penumbra/ambient separation for charts and tables. This work must preserve existing component behavior where possible, give clear migration paths, and include accessibility regression checks (WCAG AA for text, CCC where applicable).
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens exported to tokens/redwood-v2.json and tokens/redwood-v2-compact.json and checked into the design-tokens repo with a changelog
All primary button variants render with updated semantic colors and pass 4.5:1 contrast at selected sizes; secondary and tertiary variants have documented fallbacks
Table row density presets updated to use spacing-proportion tokens; charts use elevation presets with new ambient/penumbra values applied to legends and overlays
Figma components and token library updated; figma file link present in attachments; dev token mapping document created
Migration guide created with automated codemods (where feasible) and an engineer-verified rollout checklist
No production regressions reported on canary routes after one week of monitoring; metrics dashboard created to track token-related visual regressions

notes: Migration approach: provide both redwood-v1 and redwood-v2 token sets in the tokens loader; add feature flag `ui.tokens.v2` scoped to org for Dedicated customers.
Follow-up: schedule a cross-team sync with Platform (ENG) to ensure console cost/latency dashboards unaffected by token changes that touch chart overlays.
Consider future work: automated visual diffing for token PRs as part of CI to catch regressions early.
